subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

He is diligent, therefore he will _______.
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Succeed.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the blank is **2) succeed.**
 
• The sentence states that the person mentioned is diligent.
 
• Diligence refers to being hardworking, dedicated, and committed to achieving goals.
 
• When someone is diligent, it is likely that they will experience success in their endeavors.
 
 
• Example: "He is diligent, therefore he will **succeed **in his studies."
 
 
 
• Therefore, **option 2) "succeed"** is the correct answer as it aligns with the positive connotation of being diligent, indicating that the person is likely to achieve success.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other options:
 
• **"Remain" **does not appropriately fit in the context of the sentence. Diligence is related to achieving goals, not staying in a particular state.
 
• **"Fail"** is the opposite of the expected outcome when someone is diligent. It contradicts the positive attribute of diligence.
 
• **"Fall"** does not convey the intended meaning in relation to diligence. "Fall" typically implies a negative outcome or decline, which is not consistent with the positive quality of diligence.
